child.text:
[{"insert":"Suitcase Walking Lunge 

This is the final suitcase walking lunge of the cycle. Reps drop to six per side, so this should be your heaviest lunge work of the block. With a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, your grip and upper back have to work to keep you tall under the heavier load. Keep your torso upright and aim to beat Week 4 on every working set.
"}]
